ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account action against either party.
ruling.reasoning:
The cancellation was made by the rider 1 min 40 s (100 s) after acceptance — 12:54:00 → 12:55:40 [F2] — so under NS-0 the rider-cancellation branch applies and the case is governed by NS-4, which makes all cancellations made within 3 minutes of matching not chargeable [F2][NS-0][NS-4]. The $6.61 on record [F5] therefore cannot stand on the rider-cancellation route.

The alternative route to the same charge — a rider no-show under NS-1 — also fails on the settled records: no arrival confirmation exists, the driver never tapped "I'm Here" and no automatic arrival was recorded [F4][F3], so NS-1(i) is unmet; and the GPS record puts the driver's closest approach at 2138 m at 12:55:40, never within 200 m, so NS-1(ii) is unmet [F1][NS-1][NS-2]. With the rider cancelling 100 s after acceptance [F2] no continuous in-range wait could have accumulated, so NS-1(iii) fails as well [F2][F4][NS-1]. NS-2 consequently requires the rider's cancellation fee to be refunded in full [F1][F2][F4][F5][NS-2].

No waiting fee is in issue: none was charged, only the $6.61 cancellation fee appears on the record with a 1.0× multiplier and no surge component [F5][F6][NS-6]. The driver's post-trip statement "I was on my way when the rider cancelled" [F8] is a statement, not a chat message, and the system records [F1][F4] prevail over it; in any case it asserts no arrival and adds nothing [F8][F1][F4][NS-1]. There is no in-app chat at all [F7], so no contemporaneous rider-side conduct or agreement exists that could shift the fee.

The amount is the cancellation fee recorded as charged: $6.61 [F5], matching the timeline entry [F2]; no arithmetic beyond the recorded fee is needed because the trace fixes the full-fee refund under NS-4/NS-2 [F2][F5][NS-2][NS-4]. The profiles — rider with 2 upheld no-show disputes in 90 d [F12] and driver with a clean 90-day record [F13] — are background only and cannot decide the case or found a flag_account; no clause condition for flag_account (RD-6, NS-2 second limb) is met on this record [F12][F13][RD-6][NS-2].

rejected_claims.reason: Not rejected as to outcome but corrected as to route: the refund rests on NS-4 (cancellation within 3 minutes of matching, 100 s [F2]) and on NS-1/NS-2 failing, not on the no-show test alone [F2][NS-0][NS-4].
Accepted only insofar as the absence of chat [F7] leaves no rider-side conduct on record; the absence of chat is not itself proof and adds nothing beyond [F1][F3][F4][NS-2].
